name: Copilot Pages
short_description: Copilot Pages is a Microsoft 365 Copilot capability that turns Copilot chat results into a shared, editable page built on the Loop framework, so colleagues can collaborate on the content with Copilot.

evidence.quote: have one node loop co-pilot page that I think it's something new
Then I got introduced to these new what we call the co-pilot pages
Copilot pages is an editable, sharable canvas that lives right inside copilot.
Microsoft announced copilot pages in September of twenty twenty four
